Interface ICrossover

Namespace
GeneticSharp.Domain.Crossovers
Assembly
LBS.dll
Defines a interface for a crossover genetic operator. In genetic algorithms, crossover is a genetic operator used to vary the programming of a chromosome or chromosomes from one generation to the next.

It is analogous to reproduction and biological crossover, upon which genetic algorithms are based. Cross over is a process of taking more than one parent solutions and producing a child solution from them.

Crossover (Genetic Algorithm)
